instruction: Create a Drone pipeline with ARM container
output: echo 'kind: pipeline type: docker platform: os: linux arch: arm64 steps: - name: build image: golang:latest commands: - go build' > .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with plugin docker buildx
output: echo 'steps: - name: multiarch image: plugins/docker-buildx settings: repo: owner/app tags: latest platforms: - linux/amd64 - linux/arm64' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with OCI images via Kaniko
output: echo 'steps: - name: kaniko image: plugins/kaniko settings: repo: registry.example.com/app tags: latest registry: registry.example.com' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with Ansible plugin
output: echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: plugins/ansible settings: playbook: deploy.yml inventory: hosts.ini' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with Terraform plugin
output: echo 'steps: - name: infra image: plugins/terraform settings: action: apply dir: infra/' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with Helm plugin
output: echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: plugins/helm settings: chart: ./charts/app release: my-app namespace: production' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Create a Drone pipeline that runs on cron and push
output: echo 'steps: - name: test image: golang commands: - go test when: event: [ push, cron ]' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with custom clone depth
output: echo 'clone: depth: 1 steps: - name: build image: golang commands: - go build' > .drone.yml
